items.caption:
When’s the last time you deep cleaned your washing machine? 👀

I had requests to add this one into the procrastination series and it was another job I’d been putting off, so naturally I had to time it and see how long it actually takes ⏱️ 

Here’s how I deep cleaned mine:

✨1.  Clean the filter
Check your machine’s instructions for where the filter is, then open it carefully and remove any debris. Have a towel or shallow container ready as water may come out.

🧼 2. Clean the detergent drawer
Remove the drawer and give it a thorough scrub, paying particular attention to any build-up around the compartments. I just used washing up liquid for mine as I didn’t have much build up but to tackle mould you could use white vinegar or something stronger like astonish mould and mildew spray. 

🫧 3. Clean the drum and door seal
Scrub the drum. Washing up liquid will be fine for this. Then, pull back the rubber seal and remove any hair, fluff or grime that’s collected inside. Wipe all the way around the seal. Again if mould has built up here, astonish mould and mildew spray is a good option. 

🔥 4. Run a hot maintenance wash
Add your washing-machine cleaner (or whatever your machine manufacturer recommends) I didn’t have one so I used soda crystals, and run the hottest/appropriate cleaning cycle for your machine.

🌬️ 5. Let it dry
Once it’s finished, leave the door and detergent drawer open so everything can properly air out.

And that’s it. Another job we’d built up in our heads that only took 14 minutes and 11 seconds.

What other jobs do you want me to stop procrastinating and actually time? 😂
.

Who else is guilty for number 3? Walking past your dishwasher multiple times a day hoping it will miraculously empty itself? 🙈

I started cleaning and somehow ended up deep cleaning the tops of my kitchen cupboards… a job I’d been putting off for 5 MONTHS because my brain had convinced me it would take forever.

So I timed it: 10 minutes 14 seconds. 😳

Then the toaster I’d been putting off for 3 months: 4 minutes 8 seconds.

And finally, the dishwasher I apparently expect to magically empty itself all day? 2 minutes 35 seconds. 😂

Proof that the jobs we put off rarely take as long as our brains tell us they will!

What are you guilty of ignoring? 👀

I can’t believe we’re in August already! Here are 5 of your favourite home hacks of 2026 so far ✨

1. ☀️ Break down stubborn suncream stains by soaking them in citric acid before washing as normal with a scoop of Napisan or Oxi Action. Use white vinegar in place of fabric softener to help lift any lingering odours and residue.
2. 🏷️ Remove stubborn stickers with a hairdryer. The heat softens the adhesive and makes them much easier to peel away. If there’s any sticky residue left behind, a little nail varnish remover can help dissolve it.
3. ☕️ Whiten caffeine-stained mugs with a denture tablet. Just pop one into the mug with hot water, leave it to work, then rinse thoroughly.
4. 🚿 Denture tablets aren’t just for dentures! They can also help freshen up your drains. Pop one on the drain cover or down the drain if there isn’t a cover, add some hot water and let it fizz away.
5. 🧼 Use your mop for more than just floors! A mop can make cleaning larger surfaces like baths, shower trays, tiles and even windows much quicker. Just remember to use separate mop heads for different areas!

Which one is your favourite? 👇

Who else avoids cleaning their bathrooms? 👀

I was convinced this would take me 45 minutes to an hour… but it literally took 22 minutes and 29 seconds! Plus I probably could’ve shaved off another couple of minutes if I didn’t have to keep moving the camera around too 😂

But this is exactly why I’ve started timing the cleaning jobs I procrastinate because my brain massively exaggerates how long they’ll take, I put them off, and then they become even bigger jobs in my head.

So if there’s a cleaning job you’ve been avoiding, take this as your sign to time it because trust me, it won’t take as long as your brain tells you it will 🧼

Let me know in the comments, what job have you been putting off? 👇🏼

items.caption:
What’s one job you’ve been putting off because your brain keeps telling you it’ll take ages? 👀

After so many of you asked me to do another one, here’s round two of timing the jobs I’ve been avoiding to see how long they actually take ⏱️

I’ve realised my brain is really good at convincing me that certain jobs are going to take forever… so I keep putting them off but this little experiment is definitely helping to retrain my brain!

This week’s results:
✨ Windows: procrastinated for 5 weeks - actually took 12 minutes 53 seconds
✨ Kettle: procrastinated for 3 months - actually took 7 minutes 19 seconds (using my citric acid hack!)
✨ Chairs: procrastinated for 3 weeks - actually took 11 minutes and 21 seconds 

This week I also realised something else… I kept waiting until I felt motivated to start, but the motivation came once I’d got going! 

Now tell me… what’s been sitting on your to-do list for weeks (or even months)? 👇
